rules.text: Every approach shows a valid signal (red, yellow or green) and a non-negative, finite queue.
The N/S and E/W directions are never both non-red (green or yellow) in the same second.
Before a direction turns green, the opposite direction has been red for at least all_red_seconds.
A green always ends in yellow, and every yellow lasts at least yellow_seconds before red.
No approach waits at red with vehicles queued for more than 200 seconds.

citations.claim: Step 65 was NS yellow with EW red, so no all-red had started yet

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (W at t=66, duration 1) – with no preemption the cycle proceeds NS yellow -> all-red (4s) -> EW green, so all_red_clearance is satisfied

args.explanation: Emergency preemption on W at t=66 immediately forces EW green while NS was still in yellow (step 65) and then green before that, skipping the required 4s all-red clearance and truncating yellow to 1s. The controller does not insert yellow+all-red when emergency becomes active; it jumps directly to the emergency direction green, violating all_red_clearance (0s instead of 4s) and also yellow_duration.

description: At step 65 the intersection shows yellow on one axis (top-left and bottom-right) while the opposite axis is red, but at step 66 the opposite axis is already green with no intermediate frame where all approaches are red. The yellow therefore lasts only a single step before the conflicting direction turns green, visibly skipping the clearance interval.
